ariadneApp is a web app version of the ariadne package designed to interactively
weave resources across the ariadne graph. It is openly available at
[this address](https://ariadneapp-minotaur.2.rahtiapp.fi/)

Provide workflow supported with screenshots.

# Reproducibility

R session information:

```{r reproduce, echo=FALSE}
# Session info
options(width = 120)
sessionInfo()
```
